intro: Across 15 articles dated 12 April 2026 to 23 September 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of OpenAI spans technology, critical infrastructure, government, software development, and artificial-intelligence sectors. Lazarus Group, TeamPCP, and Winos 4.0 feature among the top threat actors tracked. Affected regions include Global, United states, China, EU, and Ukraine. The severity mix comprises 5 high, 4 medium, and 2 informational items. Reporting examines how OpenAI-related systems and services intersect with these actors, sectors, and regions over the five-month period, with Lazarus Group drawing the most sustained attention across the archive.
